candidates.what: Two tables of invented/Coptic-Greek-like numeral signs: 3 lines of ~12-14 signs each, with Hebrew headings (al-kabir / al-saghir) at line ends. PGP says first table pairs all Hebrew numerals with Coptic numerals, second pairs them on unclear principle. A sign-correspondence table (key-like), no running ciphertext on it. Late (13th c+).

Columns of numerals in Coptic/Greek-like signs (lists of contributions, 5576 AM; geomancy tag) plus tally-stroke blocks; accounts in unusual numeral signs, no text-like sign groups. Borderline, may merit a second look.
Verso: columns of repeated Eastern Arabic numerals 1-9 and sums; numeral practice.
Pen trials: rows of repeated Hebrew letters with dots; writing practice.
Accounts in Hebrew script (Ottoman shipping), ordinary words and numerals.
One line of large Hebrew letters alone on a leaf; too short, pen trial.
Hebrew alphabet practice, letters in odd order, large square letters; pen exercise.

Hebrew text lines (repeated formula, signature practice Rahamim Qazni) interleaved with ~20 ornate looped charakteres-like marks at top, between lines and at foot; no linguistic structure; may be calligraphic signature flourishes.
Geomancy: rows of dot/stroke figures; top two lines of dotted numeral-like signs, probably geomantic notation, not ciphertext.
Scorpion amulet. Hebrew letter list with mem-alef style endings in two columns plus a hatched circular charakter; readable Hebrew letters, magic formula, not cipher.
Accounts with numerals, star-of-David lattice doodle; no cipher.

Hebrew alphabet drill: abgd... line, then a line with atbash-style pairs (at, bsh, gr, dq...) and vowel-point rows. School/instructional table of the atbash pairing, not a cipher text.
Repeated Hebrew alphabet lines, pen trials.
Hebrew alphabet written three times, then plain Hebrew line (Ps 45:2 phrase); pen trial.
